mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a pleasant 70 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park.

Verona is focusing on community well-being this September. Mayor Luke Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to address food insecurity affecting many families, and also as Suicide Prevention Month to raise awareness and provide resources for those in need.
There is a lot to do in town today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena, and live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street at Bering Drive where drivers were cited for licensing and right of way violations.
Today's flavor is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM.
